answer_1.quote: We train MORAL TRANSFORMERs to automatically generate new RoTs that describe previously unseen human-chatbot interactions

answer_2.quote: Quantitatively, we report standard ROUGE including ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-2 (R2) and ROUGE-L (R-L), BLEU, BERTScore (BScore), and the average length (Avg. Len).

answer_4.quote: Qualitatively, we run a human evaluation for the following constructs: well-formedness ... fluency ... and ... relevance ... Three workers annotate each generation
answer_4.guideline: workers annotate ... for well-formedness (yes or no), fluency (on a scale of 1-5), and relevance (on a scale of 1-5)
